text:
sophie: heads-up — main CI turned red right after the merge from #2487 :eyes:
ci-bot: Build failed on main (job 4321) — https://ci.internal/jobs/4321 — failing test: test_routing::test_kv_cache
sophie: cc @devon @raul — can one of you grab this?
devon: on it. looking at job logs now.
devon: quick log snippet:
```
FAIL tests/inference/test_routing.py::test_kv_cache - AssertionError: expected 0.1 < 0.05
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/inference/test_routing.py", line 87, in test_kv_cache
    assert hit_rate > 0.1
```

devon: that assertion looks like the KV cache hit-rate regressed, could be load-related or a test flake
raul: I landed that merge — it touched batching + routing config but only minor. pinging in case I introduced something obvious
mira: can we /rerun job 4321 once before bisecting? if it flakes we shouldn't block a rollback
sophie: +1 to rerun first. devon — can you kick a rerun and report back?
devon: started rerun (job 4323). if it fails again I'll kick a bisect with the post-merge commits range
ci-bot: Rerun started: job 4323 — queued on gpu-pool-2
devon: rerun finished — FAILED as well, same assertion
devon: starting an automated bisect between commits c1a3f2 (yesterday)..HEAD — creating bisect job
raul: if bisect narrows to my change I can revert quickly, otherwise let's keep investigating
mira: devon, drop the bisect link when ready and tag owners, I'll coordinate a hotfix if needed
devon: bisect job created: https://ci.internal/bisect/987 — first repro at commit c4d9a7
sophie: tagging @raul and @mira on the bisect result — please take a look when you can
raul: looking now — that commit modifies batch sizing thresholds, plausible cause. I'll run the failing test locally
raul: local run reproduced failure: same assert. reverting my commit locally fixed the test
sophie: ok plan: raul will open a revert PR, devon will keep monitoring bisect and ci-bot will watch for any new failures. if revert lands and CI green we ship it to unblock
devon: noted. creating revert PR in 10m :shipit:
mira: thanks everyone — please add a short postmortem comment in the PR once we stabilise
sophie: thanks all :thumbsup:
